stats.title: Messi keeps beating the model
stats.note: Expected goals rate every shot by how often that kind of chance goes in. Scoring more than them means finishing better than the average shooter.
stats.text: Lionel Messi has 25 goals from 20.4 expected goals for Inter Miami this season.

stats.title: Arsenal lead the EPL race
stats.note: Our title chance plays out the rest of the season thousands of times with our match forecasts and counts how often each club finishes first.
stats.text: We make Arsenal 67% to win the EPL, from thousands of simulated seasons.

stats.title: Antonelli is out of sight
stats.note: A win is worth 25 points, so every 25 clear is a race the rest need back.
stats.text: Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads by 102 points with 6 rounds left; our title chance >99.9%.

stats.title: The Brewers are the favourites

stats.title: The Ravens have moved the most

stats.title: Oettinger has been a wall
stats.note: Goals saved above expected compares each shot faced with how often that kind of shot goes in. Positive means better than an average goalie.
stats.text: Jake Oettinger (DAL) has saved 9.1 more goals than an average goalie would on the same shots this season.
